## About

I design products and make them look and feel better for real users, not just for mockups. My background spans UI/UX and product design, front-end development, and computer science, with a strong bias toward applied, hands-on work over purely academic exercises.

Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at KIIT University, India. I interned at Article Craft Pvt Ltd, where I designed the website and dashboard UI for an email scraping tool.

I'm also comfortable working with AI tools to speed up research and find references.
